{{Top|leg}}
'''Pleek''' was a kind of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. Its wood paneled the corridors of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> A table in [[Moff Assembly Hall]] on the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] was also made of pleek wood.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>
